newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER,TRADE HOURS EXTENDED.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER,TRADE HOURS EXTENDED.

text.p: IPE natural gas prices eased lower on Friday, the first day of new extended trading hours.
A total of 125 lots changed hands, a lighter volume than in recent days, but 75 lots were traded in what used to be the midday break between midday and 1400 local time.
A new balance of month contract was also introduced on Friday. August was untraded but fairly well bid and offered. The contract settled at 9.29 pence a therm.
Further out, October was the busiest month, with 75 lots traded. It settled unchanged at 10.95 pence. November slipped 0.230 pence to 13.30 pence, while March slipped 0.260 pence to 13.940 pence.
Prices were talked lower across the forward curve, and a sharp fall in bids stifled trade with sellers reluctant to drop offers lower.
